faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.whatIs.question: What is Vikunja?
faq.whatIs.answer: Vikunja is an open-source, self-hostable to-do app. It helps you organize your tasks and projects with features like list, kanban, gantt, and table views — all while keeping your data under your control.
faq.free.question: Is Vikunja free and open source?
faq.free.answer: Yes. Vikunja is licensed under the AGPLv3 and completely free to self-host. If you prefer not to manage your own server, [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}) offers a paid hosted option.
faq.install.question: How do I install Vikunja?
faq.install.answer: You can install Vikunja using Docker, native binaries for your platform, or sign up for [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}). Use the [install wizard]({installUrl}) for a guided setup.
faq.selfHost.question: Do I have to self-host Vikunja?
faq.selfHost.answer: No. While self-hosting is a great option, [Vikunja Cloud]({cloudLink}) gives you a fully managed instance with automatic updates, backups, and zero maintenance. It's the easiest way to get started and directly supports the continued development of Vikunja.
faq.import.question: Can I import tasks from Todoist, Trello, or Microsoft To-Do?
faq.import.answer: Yes. Vikunja has built-in migration support for Todoist, Trello, Microsoft To-Do, and other platforms. You can import your existing tasks and projects directly from the Vikunja interface.

home.ownData.text: Run Vikunja on your own infrastructure. Your tasks, your projects, your rules. Open-source under the AGPLv3 — you can read every line of code.

home.team.text: Start with your personal to-do list. When your team needs it too, share projects, assign tasks, and collaborate — without switching to a different tool.

home.quote.title: Getting more organized is hard
home.quote.why: I built Vikunja because there was no good Open-Source Tool to do what I wanted. Privacy is important. For me, you should be able to look at the code of a piece of software you use a lot. Especially if it is something like a to-do app you use daily.
home.quote.cloud: Vikunja Cloud is the best way for me to make sure the project can continue to live on and be self-sustainable. Being completely bootstrapped, the users of the software are the top priority and not some VC.
